title: Missing required context
description: abs preview with several required Azure-context flags omitted (--resource-group, --location, --bot-name, --endpoint). ABS scaffolding never guesses or silently switches context, so it fails fast with a typed missing-context error (exit 2) naming every absent flag, before touching any Azure dependency.

json.errorMessage: Missing required argument(s): --resource-group, --location, --bot-name, --endpoint. ABS scaffolding never guesses or silently switches Azure context.

stderr: Missing required argument(s): --resource-group, --location, --bot-name, --endpoint. ABS scaffolding never guesses or silently switches Azure context.
